function: Joint downlink AP precoding and RIS phase-shift design maximizing sum spectral efficiency, learned by multi-agent RL with each AP as an agent (pp. 1-3).
system: RIS-aided cell-free mMIMO downlink: 4 APs with 8 antennas, 4 single-antenna UEs, 4 reflecting RISs with 16 elements; band not stated (pp. 4-5).
method: Multi-agent reinforcement learning: fuzzy-logic MADDPG (FL-MADDPG), actor-critic, centralized training with distributed execution, two-layer actor for precoding and phase shift (pp. 2-5).
data_channel: Simulated Rayleigh fading with large-scale factors (model from [22]), random UE positions in a 50 m square; no standard model, dataset, or measurements (pp. 2, 5).
test_conditions: Trained and evaluated in the same simulated setup; sweeps over AP antennas, RISs, and RIS elements; no cross-setting test reported (pp. 5-6).
baselines: Non-learned: MMSE, ZF, AO-based algorithm [23]. Learned: MADDPG, the proposed method without fuzzy logic (pp. 5-6).
metrics: Sum spectral efficiency (bit/s/Hz) versus AP antennas, RISs and RIS elements; reward versus training episode; computational complexity orders (pp. 4-6).
complexity: Table I gives complexity orders: MADDPG exponential in the number of APs L, FL-MADDPG linear in L and in fuzzy agents NF (pp. 4-5).
q1_support: p. 5: "we adopt the channel model from [22]". Own simulated Rayleigh fading with large-scale factors (page 2, Eq. 4) following [22]; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 5: "to improve the generalization ability of". Only a claim that the experience pool size helps generalization; Figs. 3-5 sweep antennas, RISs and RIS elements and are not described as tests of a model trained in another setting; no cross-setting test is reported.
q3_support: p. 5: "demonstrating that the integration of FL into" MADDPG. Non-learned MMSE, ZF and AO-based [23] are compared on sum-SE (Figs. 3-5), but the only learned comparison, MADDPG, is the proposed FL-MADDPG without its fuzzy-logic module, an ablation that does not count.
q4_support: p. 4: "We compare the computational complexity of different" algorithms. Table I (page 5) gives complexity orders for MADDPG and for the proposed FL-MADDPG, and page 4 states linear growth with the number of APs after integrating FL.
q5_support: p. 5: "In the proposed RIS-aided cell-free network simulation," the setup is the authors' own (50 m region, random UEs); no link or DOI for code or data and no public dataset or measurement appears in the six pages.
notes: PDF is the arXiv version (arXiv:2404.14092v1) and carries no DOI, so the DOI-title match cannot be checked from the PDF; title and content fit an IEEE TVT 2024 paper on RIS-aided cell-free mMIMO. q3 is borderline: non-learned baselines exist (MMSE, ZF, AO-based [23]), but the only learned baseline is MADDPG, which the paper says FL is integrated into (page 5), so I treated it as an ablation of the proposed method; the reviewer may flip q3 to 1 if MADDPG is judged a standard-algorithm baseline. q2: the generalization sentence on page 5 is a claim without a test. Fig. 3 shows MMSE above both learned methods.
